context: Add scripts/pr_refresh_certification.py as a pure core with injected event, Git, ruleset, PR, Actions-run, and check-run data. Follow scripts/path_filter_decision.py's stdlib bootstrap and structured-output conventions. Return a typed decision such as shadow_eligible or full_required plus stable reason codes; missing, stale, ambiguous, or untrusted input always returns full_required. Do not add a domain map.
description: Implement a standard-library, fail-closed classifier that can prove whether a pull_request synchronize event is an exact merge of the current develop base into a previously fully certified same-repository PR head. The classifier is evidence generation only in this TODO: it must never skip a CI job or publish a required success context. It must bind the prior certification to the PR number, feature head, tested base SHA, Actions run and check-run IDs, workflow fingerprint, synthetic merge/tree identity, and selected lanes. Version 1 permits at most one shadow-eligible refresh after a full certification.

anti_patterns.dont: Accept a successful check name without its Actions run base and workflow provenance
anti_patterns.instead: bind check IDs to exact run head, base, and workflow fingerprint
anti_patterns.why: the check may certify a different merge tree

anti_patterns.dont: Inspect github.sha or default checkout HEAD as the feature branch
anti_patterns.instead: use pull_request.head.sha and explicit fetched objects
anti_patterns.why: pull_request workflows normally check out a synthetic merge ref

anti_patterns.dont: Treat an earlier fast certification as a full-certification parent
anti_patterns.instead: force full_required after one fast refresh
anti_patterns.why: that permits an unverified attestation chain

anti_patterns.dont: Use a hand-authored path-domain dependency map
anti_patterns.instead: use conservative global invalidators and keep dynamic safety as a later decision
anti_patterns.why: path domains cannot prove Python and runtime coupling

preserves.behavior: Every live required context is discovered from ruleset 15611785 and validated through Check Runs
The classifier cannot cause or authorize CI skipping in this TODO
Unknown input, API failure, fork PR, force-push, rebase, authored commit, conflict edit, or current-head/base drift returns full_required
Version 1 allows only one exact refresh after a full certification
